Builddrone 0.6.1 deploys documentation only after a successful PyPI publish.
A failed package upload no longer publishes a documentation version for a
release that did not ship.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Publishing

### Documentation follows a successful PyPI upload

The `docs` job in `.github/workflows/workflow.yml` now runs after `publish`.
On a version tag, checks and the package build still run first. PyPI Trusted
Publishing uploads the distributions. Documentation deploys only when that
upload succeeds.

Pull requests and branch pushes still skip both publish and documentation.
The package build no longer waits on the documentation job.
